_ytflow_note: Card/plate fusion — Epic 10 '확정 방향: 카드-배경은 최종적으로 한 장으로 융합한다'. Takes the composited still (plate + cards, rendered motionless through video.py's own card chain) and re-draws it so the frame becomes ONE image instead of a sprite on a plate. MASKED, per Jay's spec: node '2' carries the card coverage mask, which is eroded and inverted so the pass re-draws the plate and a ring straddling each card's edge while protecting the card's interior. Unmasked probing (2026-08-08, S00403) showed why the mask is not optional — at denoise 0.40 the D-class badge '213 5' collapsed into nonsense glyphs and the face became a different person; 0.20 was safe but barely fused. The mask decouples the two: the seam can be re-drawn hard while identity and insignia are untouched. Injection points: node '1' (still), node '2' (mask), node '3'.denoise. NO LoRAs — the background workflow loads darkness_xl_v2.safetensors, which Story 10.3 measured as an SD1.5-layout file that silently fails to patch an SDXL checkpoint. Marker stays false until a live probe passes.

_meta.title: The composited still — plate + cards, motion off, 1920x1080
Card coverage — white where a card covers the frame. Measured by rendering the same card chain over black and over white, never re-derived from placement arithmetic.
Same checkpoint the plates were generated with, so the redraw stays in the plate's style
Erode 16px INTO the card: everything outside this is fair game to re-draw, so the ring that gets fused straddles the card's edge rather than stopping at it.
Denoise where this is 1: the plate everywhere, plus the 16px rim inside each card. The card's interior is 0 and survives untouched.
Round-trip through IMAGE only because ImageBlur is the available blur; there is no MaskBlur on this install.
Soften the mask edge so the protected/re-drawn transition does not print a hard seam of its own
The still IS the init latent — this is img2img, not generation
The whole point: noise is only applied where the mask allows, so denoise can be raised without touching the approved card
Positive — describes the medium, not the content; the content is the still
